tuition.quote: For the 2027/28 academic year, the University of Sheffield will charge new full-time overseas undergraduates, tuition fees between £27,650 and £34,670 (except for Medicine and Dentistry courses, see below).
tuition.notes: 'Tuition fees for undergraduate overseas students', section 'Your tuition fee'. A university-wide range for the 2027/28 academic year, not a Computer Science figure: the course page's fee block is a JavaScript look-up and the look-up tool's host (tools.sheffield.ac.uk) has an unreachable robots.txt, so the CS amount was not read (topup_round10). Kept as a printed range ({min, max}); no figure inside it is chosen. The same page: 'The tuition fee you pay in your first year will be the same for each year of your course.' The page also prints the 2026/27 range (£25,000 and £32,100), not used.
